mentions.name: Rust markdownlint-cli2
mentions.description: A Rust implementation of markdownlint-cli2, a command-line markdown linter, built to eliminate the Node.js runtime dependency that projects currently need when using the original tool.
mentions.problem: Using markdownlint-cli2 requires a node dependency in projects, which the author finds tiresome.
mentions.source_excerpt: am working on a Rust version of markdownlint-cli2. I'm tired of having a node dependency in my projects
